name: reactive-omni-aegis
description: Multi-Track Autonomous DeFi Protection, Personal Automation & Neural Threat Shield for Reactive Omni (CometBFT ~1s Finality)
author: Ronan Chen Lopes <ronanchenlopes@gmail.com> (@LBCron)

scripts.build: npx solcjs --optimize --bin --abi --base-path . --include-path lib -o out/solc contracts/OmniAegisReactiveGuard.sol contracts/AegisVaultCallbackReceiver.sol contracts/AIThreatSignalEmitter.sol contracts/mocks/MockOmniSystemContract.sol contracts/mocks/MockCallbackProxy.sol contracts/mocks/MockDEXPool.sol contracts/mocks/MockLendingMarket.sol test/OmniAegis.t.sol
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s ai_agent -p 'test_*.py' -v && node --test test/omni-aegis.test.js
